about: Pairs of colors for Oinam UI. Each sets three tokens, ink, cloud, and milk, in light and dark, written in OKLCH; every other shade is mixed from them. The page for each is https://oinam.dev/colors/<id>/<name>/, and the name is optional. Kept by hand; scripts/colors.js writes the pages from it.

colors.name: base
colors.title: Base
colors.description: The default: a cool near-black on a grey cloud, with almost no color at all.

colors.name: navy
colors.title: Navy
colors.description: A bright navy for text by day, and a deep one for the ground by night, on a cloud of the same blue.

colors.name: paper
colors.title: Paper
colors.description: Soft black on warm paper, like a printed page.

colors.name: carbon
colors.title: Carbon
colors.description: Black on white, as plain as a screen allows, with no tint in either.

colors.name: forest
colors.title: Forest
colors.description: A deep green on a pale green cloud, and the woods at night.

colors.name: clay
colors.title: Clay
colors.description: A dark earth red on a warm, faintly pink cloud.
